description: Request files with a link — they upload to you, with no account and no ads. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

days.description: How many days a request link would stay open for uploads, at most 30; there is no permanent option. This call only describes such a link and creates nothing; creating one is a separate, signed-in POST to the createAt path returned.

maxFiles.description: How many files the link would accept before closing itself, at most 100. Each file is also capped at what the owner's own plan allows and counts against their storage.

name: request_a_file
title: Request a File
